meta.name: knowledge-agent
meta.description: Build and query AI-powered knowledge bases from claude-mem observations. Use when users want to create focused "brains" from their observation history, ask questions about past work patterns, or compile expertise on specific topics.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从对话历史构建可查询的知识库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望从日常对话中自动提炼知识并随时查询
copy.tagline_en: Build queryable knowledge bases from conversation history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to automatically extract knowledge from daily conversations and query it anytime

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能把你的 claude-mem 观察记录按项目、类型、概念、文件、日期或语义搜索筛成语料库，加载进一个会话，然后基于这个语料库回答你的提问，追问会保留上下文。
howto.when: 当你想从观察历史里建一个聚焦的「知识库」，或想就过去的工作模式提问、汇总某个主题的经验时触发。

say.text: 用 claude-mem 的记录帮我建一个 hooks 相关的知识库
say.note: 会执行 build_corpus 生成语料库

say.text: 把 hooks-expertise 这个语料库加载起来
问 hooks-expertise：5 个生命周期钩子分别何时触发？
say.note: 执行 query_corpus，基于语料库作答

howto.what_en: Claude filters your claude-mem observations by project, type, concepts, files, dates or a semantic query into a corpus, loads it into an AI session, and answers your questions from it, keeping context across follow-ups.
howto.when_en: Use it when you want a focused knowledge base built from your observation history, to ask questions about past work patterns, or to compile expertise on a topic.

say_en.text: Build a knowledge base on hooks from my claude-mem records
say_en.note: Runs build_corpus and creates the corpus
Runs prime_corpus to start a session

say_en.text: Ask hooks-expertise: when does each lifecycle hook fire?
